title: specaudit-ctf coverage catalog
description: Survey map of alternative heads, invocable arms, and methodology-only rows. Not a ship list of adapters. Support tier is independent of the deprecated curated compatibility flag.

kind.description: head = alternative agent or CLI head; arm = invocable tool, scanner, MCP, or CLI adapter candidate; methodology-only = specification, curriculum, or teach-only knowledge.

protocols.description: Protocols the row speaks. Use none alone when there is no invocable surface.

curated.description: Deprecated compatibility flag. True when a specialized handler exists in this cut. Not equivalent to tier=maintained.

tier.description: Lifecycle/support tier. research and experimental are not a validator support promise. held is never invocable. maintained is not implied by curated.

held_reason.description: Required when tier is held. Written reason invoke is refused.

notes.description: Short public note. Must stay inside the language bar.
